BiblicalUsage: hereg is the word for slaughter, a killing. I meet it 5 times across the Bible, and Esther is a good place to see it plainly. It says what it says, and I take it at face value.
TheologicalSignificance: What hereg tells me is that judgment is real, and so is the mercy that saves us from it. What I take from it is this — the plain sense is the safe sense.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
